proposed_capability: MoonWake P00 governance correction then P01 harness enforcement: prefer the oldest explicitly eligible lab-created disposable Sims 4 trial save over newer eligible lab-created disposable saves, without treating age as authorization or auto-selecting, resuming, modifying or overwriting any save.
player_save_control_impact: Chronological age only sorts existing LAB_DISPOSABLE candidates which pass the canonical bound lab origin and current-run selection guard. USER_PROTECTED, UNKNOWN_PROTECTED and LAB_CONTINUATION are never promoted. No disk save scan, Resume, AUTO_SELECT, copy, delete, modify, overwrite or game input. The ranked list is advisory only; player and local screen admission remain independently necessary.
expected_outcome: A repo-owned oldest-first preference contract, fail-closed read-only candidate ranking against an operator-selected lab registry with attested creation times, CLI/help, regression tests and CI validator, governed by MoonWake P00 followed by P01. No changed product-code or games.
negative_tests: A most-recent eligible lab save never outranks an older eligible lab save
Older protected and continuation saves never become disposable
Missing or contradictory lab age or origin evidence abstains
Unbound run/capture/game patch, duplicate alias or ID abstains
No newest-first or auto Resume fallback
No path to save IO or game input
Feature branch consultation commit precedes behavior changes
rollback_path: Revert the isolated branch/PR; no EA save, native mod, host settings or user data are touched.
unresolved_unknowns: Current private host lab save registry entries and their creation timestamps are not accessible via GitHub provider
Local Windows game and UI age display were not inspected
MoonWake local stage walker cannot be executed through the GitHub provider
decision_rationale: P00 governs save authority and explicit age preference; P01 supplies only non-mutating harness enforcement, rather than changing product logic or initiating game control.
